entrypointBlock: GET / returned Cloudflare HTTP 403; static public modules and API content returned HTTP 200.

contracts.criticalChance: Final value: derived.critChance. The complete raw DEX-share critical formula is not inferred; no guaranteed critical overflow is claimed.
contracts.support: GameApp uses derived.harceroStats directly when available. Effective support fields and supportRaw remain separate; equipment-only sums are never substituted.
contracts.softCap: Below cap/2: raw. Above: cap/2 + (cap/2)*(raw-cap/2)/(raw-cap/2+cap/2). Diminishing returns, not a hard clipping loss.
contracts.evade: GameApp ZS + Ls uses character DEX share, level reference share and derived.evadeBonus. The result is labelled normal reference, never an actual named boss chance.
contracts.rewards: Effective bonus = (min(2, multiplier-paid+equipmentBonus)+paid-1)*100. Requires explicit paid amounts and XP/Nyang equipment bonus. Audited drop equipment term is zero.

limitations: No authenticated character or gameplay write tested
Static module availability does not prove the latest root entrypoint
Missing/changed data hides the affected normal stat
No automatic equip is advertised as live-proven
Pet source/model/tooltip remain enabled in normal mode
